story.originalTitle: After Kimi Antonelli’s Italian GP win, is the F1 world title fight over? Our writers have their say
story.summaryEn: Kimi Antonelli won the Italian Grand Prix from 19th on the grid, extending his Formula 1 world championship lead to 66 points. With a maximum of 10 rounds left, he is in a supremely strong position to seal the 2026 world title.
detailZh: 在基米·安东内利赢得意大利大奖赛之后，F1 世界冠军之争是否已经结束了？我们的撰稿人们各有看法
在安东内利惊艳赢得意大利大奖赛之后，他在 F1 世界锦标赛中的领先优势扩大到了 66 分……
基米·安东内利在意大利大奖赛上从发车区第 19 位发车并最终夺冠，这是一场宣言式的表现，并将他在世界一级方程式锦标赛中的领先优势扩大到 66 分。
在最多还剩 10 站比赛的情况下——具体取决于卡塔尔和阿布扎比大奖赛以及中东局势——这位意大利车手已经处于极其有利的位置，有望锁定 2026 年的世界冠军。
那么，2026年F1世界冠军之争就此结束了吗？我们的专栏作者们各抒己见。
要从现在开始丢掉冠军，安东内利得出现一代人才会遇到的大崩盘才有可能
我不想在欧洲赛段结束之前就断言一切已成定局，但这一站感觉意义非凡。从发车位的第19位一路杀到夺冠，而且击败的是像拉塞尔和维斯塔潘这样领跑车群的车手，这将被载入史册，成为安东内利首次向世人展示其F1世界冠军实力的一刻。
还剩大约10轮比赛，落后66分的差距并非无法逆转——只要他遭遇两次退赛，压力就会立刻压到这位20岁车手的头上——但他似乎丝毫没有被这些影响，甚至可以说，他现在的表现比他在F1崭露头角的职业生涯中的任何时候都要出色。
安东内利已经证明，他可以在需要时稳稳拿下好成绩，也能在胜利近在眼前时全力冲击冠军；这个周末在蒙扎，他实际上连续做到了这两件事。
是的，尽管每场比赛都输给拉塞尔只拿第二，这在数学上还不能确保锁定冠军，但由于他的队友预计将在阿塞拜疆因更换引擎而接受从发车末位起步的处罚，他有一个绝佳的机会把这种局面变成现实。
安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯；乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯
悬念还没结束——但拉塞尔将需要一些运气
安东内利在蒙扎确实给了拉塞尔争冠希望一记重击，但截至今天，还剩下10场比赛——仍有258分可以争取。
拉塞尔的落后已经扩大到66分，而且形势对他不利，他的沮丧情绪可以理解地会不断累积——尽管周日的失利中他表现得非常大度。
要弥补如此巨大的差距，拉塞尔需要天时地利人和全都到位。安东内利很少有失手的比赛；本赛季至今的13场大奖赛中，他有11次登上领奖台，而拉塞尔只有7次。
这种惊人的稳定性通常会导致世界冠军的诞生，很少有反例。巧合的是，反例就发生在去年。奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里在前13轮比赛中同样是11次登台，当时他领先队友兰多·诺里斯16分，领先马克斯·维斯塔潘81分，但最终他的得分却被两人反超。
除此之外，最近一次这样的情况是尼科·罗斯伯格在2014年创造的。这位德国车手在赛季前13场比赛中登上了11次领奖台，但队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿自己也拿到了10次领奖台，并且积分榜上只落后22分。换句话说，只有当前差距的三分之一不到。
所以，这样的追赶并非没有先例，维斯塔潘就证明过这一点——但那次的情形并不可比，因为拉塞尔和安东内利开的是同一辆车，而去年红牛车手和迈凯伦车手则不同。因此，虽然还有希望，但这位英国车手如今确实希望渺茫。
在安东内利赢得蒙扎站冠军之后，几乎已经没有什么能阻止他夺得今年的总冠军了。如果之前还有人怀疑，这个周末大概已经消除了预测其他结果的一切理由——除非这位意大利车手在赛道之外出了大问题。
毕竟，伊萨克·哈德贾尔也并不是计划好要缺席几场比赛的。所以，只要安东内利在接下来的几个月里远离拳击手套，他应该就没问题。只要他能出现在发车区——显然，无论从哪个位置发车——他看起来都将在20岁那年成为世界冠军。
而且这不仅仅是关于安东内利的事。拉塞尔作为他目前最接近的竞争对手，不仅要弥合巨大的积分差距——他还必须做到一件更难的事：保持自己仍然能在任何一个比赛周末击败安东内利的信念。
考虑到本赛季的走势，以及这位意大利车手进步的速度，这位英国车手看到自己的年轻队友变得如此出色，心里一定感到非常胆怯。
蒙扎也证实了法拉利很可能已经出局。夏尔·勒克莱尔其实从来都没真正参与争冠，而现在他落后太多，已经无法认真考虑冠军了。而汉密尔顿看上去也没有一辆能够持续挑战梅赛德斯车手们的赛车。同样的情况也适用于诺里斯和迈凯伦，他们车队本周末的弱点再次暴露无遗。
我真的看不到拉塞尔还有任何翻盘的可能。真的看不到。是的，还有很多积分可以争取，一级方程式历史上也发生过更离奇的事情，而且那些强大的梅赛德斯动力单元一直像是玻璃大炮（表面强大实则脆弱）。这些我都明白。
但安东内利取胜的方式，以及在梅赛德斯不处于惯常统治地位时拿到任何一个可得成绩的表现，对于一个20岁的车手来说是相当了不起的。
拉塞尔正在扭转局面，但即便如此，似乎也不足以经常战胜安东内利，而这正是他必须做到的事。不是像他现在大致做到的那样跟上节奏，而是要彻底压倒安东内利。
我只是觉得这不会发生，因为恐怕拉塞尔已经在这位年轻的意大利车手身上遇到了对手。
更重要的是，意大利大奖赛本应是安东内利的一次缓冲，是他启用补救机会（joker）的一场比赛——启用第五套动力单元本应是一场止损行动。结果他非但没有受损，反而给了拉塞尔一记心理上的重击。与此同时，拉塞尔之后仍然要接受引擎处罚，而且剩下的赛道中没有一条会像这里这样容易超车。
去年冠军争夺战的结局表明，10场比赛是一段漫长的时间，但那时是这一代最优秀的车手在后面追赶。而现在，是下一代最优秀的车手跑在最前面，而且他看起来无懈可击。我就在这里下结论。
detailEn: After Kimi Antonelli’s Italian GP win, is the F1 world title fight over? Our writers have their say
Following Antonelli’s stunning Italian GP victory, his F1 world championship lead is up to 66 points…
Kimi Antonelli’s Italian Grand Prix win from 19th on the grid was a statement performance and extends his lead in the Formula 1 world championship to 66 points.
With a maximum of 10 rounds left – subject to the Qatar and Abu Dhabi GPs and the situation in the Middle East – the Italian driver is in a supremely strong position to seal the 2026 world title.
So, is the 2026 F1 world title fight over? Our writers have their say.
It’d need to be a generational choke for Antonelli to lose it from here

I don’t want to say it is done and dusted before the European stretch of the season is over but this felt monumental. To go from 19th on the grid to victory, against the likes of George Russell and Max Verstappen at the front of the pack, is going to go down in history as the first moment Antonelli demonstrated his F1 world champion credentials.

A gap of 66 points with 10-ish rounds to go isn’t impossible to overturn – just two DNFs and the pressure is right on top of the 20-year-old – but he just doesn’t seem phased by any of it and, if anything, is driving better now than at any point in his burgeoning career in F1.
Antonelli has shown already he can bank solid results when needed, and also charge for the win when it is there for the taking; he effectively did both one after the other at Monza this weekend.

Yes, finishing second to Russell in every race still isn’t enough to mathematically seal the title, but with his team-mate expected to serve a back of the grid penalty for an engine change in Azerbaijan, he has a great opportunity to make that scenario a reality.
Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, George Russell, Mercedes
It’s not over – but Russell will need luck
Antonelli definitely dealt a sizeable blow to Russell’s title hopes in Monza but, as of today, there are 10 rounds to go – 258 points to score.
Russell’s deficit is up to 66 points, and the dynamic isn’t favourable to him, as frustration will understandably be growing – though he was very gracious in defeat on Sunday.

In order to make up such a substantial gap, Russell will need the stars to align. Antonelli doesn’t have many off days; in 13 grands prix so far this season, he has finished on the podium 11 times to Russell’s seven.

That remarkable consistency typically leads to a world title, with few examples to the contrary. Coincidentally, it happened just last year. Oscar Piastri also had 11 podiums from the first 13 rounds, by which time he was 16 points ahead of team-mate Lando Norris and 81 points clear of Max Verstappen, but he ended up outscored by both.

Other than that, the most recent one was Nico Rosberg in 2014. The German had recorded 11 podiums in the first 13 races, but team-mate Lewis Hamilton had 10 podium finishes himself and was just 22 points down in the standings. Three times fewer than the current gap, in other words.

So, such a recovery wouldn’t be unprecedented, as shown by Verstappen – but it wasn’t comparable given Russell and Antonelli have the same car, unlike the Red Bull racer and the McLaren drivers last year. So, while there’s hope, the Briton really is a long shot by now.

There’s really very little to suggest anything can still stop Antonelli from clinching the title this year after his Monza victory. If anyone had doubts before, this weekend probably removed the last arguments for predicting any other outcome - barring something going completely wrong for the Italian off track.

After all, Isack Hadjar didn’t exactly plan to miss a couple of races. So, as long as Antonelli stays away from boxing gloves for the next couple of months, he should be fine. If he shows up on the grid - regardless of where he starts, apparently - he looks set to become world champion at the age of 20.

It’s not only about Antonelli, either. Russell, still his closest rival, doesn’t just need to close a massive points gap - he has to do something even more difficult: maintain the belief that he can still beat Antonelli on any given weekend.
Given how this season has unfolded, and the speed of the Italian’s progress, it must be daunting for the Briton to see just how brilliant his young team-mate has become.

Monza also confirmed Ferrari is probably out of the picture. Charles Leclerc never really was in it, and now he’s simply too far behind to seriously think about the title. And Hamilton doesn’t appear to have a car capable of challenging the Mercedes drivers consistently. The same applies to Norris and McLaren, whose weaknesses were exposed again this weekend.

I just don't see a way back for Russell. I really don't. Yes, there are a lot of points on the table, stranger things have happened in F1, and those formidable Mercedes power units have been glass cannons. I get all that.
But the manner in which Antonelli has been amassing race wins, and collecting whichever result is available when Mercedes doesn't enjoy its usual supremacy, is a quite a marvel for a 20-year-old.

Russell is turning things around, but even that doesn't appear to be enough to be beating Antonelli on a regular basis and that's exactly what he would have to do. Not keeping pace, as he is roughly doing now, but battering Antonelli.
I just don't see it happening, because I'm afraid Russell has met his match in the young Italian.

What's more, the Italian Grand Prix was supposed to be Antonelli's mulligan, his joker race where taking his fifth power unit meant an exercise in damage limitation. Instead of sustaining damage, he has dealt Russell a mental hammer blow. Meanwhile, Russell still has to take his engine penalty later on, and there isn't a circuit left where overtaking will be this easy.

The conclusion to last year's title race has shown that 10 races is an eternity, but that was when the best driver of his generation was doing the chasing. Now, the best driver of the next generation is out in front, and he looks bulletproof. I am going to call it here.

detailZh: F1美国大奖赛：汉密尔顿在FP3中险胜维斯塔潘
法拉利在COTA的每节练习中都排名第一，进入排位赛
汉密尔顿在F1美国大奖赛的最后一节练习中排名第一，领先维斯塔潘和勒克莱尔进入奥斯汀的排位赛
在第三节的最后20分钟里，汉密尔顿是唯一打破1分35秒大关的车手，频繁的越界行为使得法拉利队友勒克莱尔无法超越他登上排行榜。
本节练习的前三圈只能用平淡无奇来形容，但随着汉密尔顿在软胎上跑出1分36.716秒，超越了多个使用中等轮胎的圈速。
不久后，小红牛车队和迈凯轮的利亚姆·劳森打破了汉密尔顿的成绩，而几位重量级选手仍在使用中等轮胎进行圈速测试。
尽管范斯特appen对换挡时的不稳定状态有所抱怨，但他凭借黄色侧壁轮胎的1分35.702秒成绩名列前茅。
汉密尔顿迅速提升了成绩，使用软胎跑出了1分35.561秒。但勒克莱尔尽管使用的是较慢的中胎，却以1分35.127秒的成绩接管了领先位置，这表明还有更多的速度可以挖掘。
进入最后20分钟，安东内利在软胎上比勒克莱尔快了十分之一，但他在9号弯道超出了赛道限制，导致这一圈被取消。
维斯塔潘遵守了白线，以1分35.061秒的成绩排名第一，红牛车队在第一区段是最快的，但汉密尔顿的成绩低于1分35秒，达到了1分34.893秒。
在整个练习过程中一直出现的赛道限制问题，也阻止了勒克莱尔重新夺回第一的位置，因为他在10号弯道越过了白线。
这意味着摩纳哥车手只能满足于排在汉密尔顿和维斯塔潘之后，为周六下午的排位赛设置了一场紧张激烈的局面。
冠军车手安东内利排在第四位，领先于梅赛德斯车队的队友乔治·拉塞尔，银箭车队似乎在纯速度上落后半步，皮亚斯蒂在难以驾驭的MCL40中排在第六位。
在奥迪车队，尼科·胡肯伯格阻止了麦克拉伦车队的兰多·诺里斯获得第七名，世界冠军的1分35.2秒成绩也因为第十弯的赛道限制而被取消。
阿尔派车队的皮埃尔·加斯利排在第九位，落后汉密尔顿一秒，伊萨克·哈德贾在第二辆小红牛车队中排在第十位，这位法国车手因为他的赛车操控问题而感到沮丧。
detailEn: F1 United States GP: Lewis Hamilton pips Max Verstappen in FP3
Ferrari heads into qualifying having topped every practice session at COTA
Lewis Hamilton finished final practice on top at Formula 1's United States Grand Prix, leading Max Verstappen and Charles Leclerc into qualifying at Austin.

Hamilton was the only driver to break the 1m35s barrier in the final 20 minutes of third practice, as frequent track limits transgressions kept Ferrari team-mate Leclerc from leapfrogging him on the leaderboard.
Following an opening quarter of the session which can only be described as pedestrian, action picked up as Hamilton set a 1m36.716s on softs to get ahead of a number of medium-tyred install laps.
His time was soon beaten by Liam Lawson in the Racing Bulls and McLaren's Oscar Piastri, while several heavy hitters kept turning laps on medium tyres instead.
Verstappen even went top courtesy of a 1m35.702s on the yellow sidewall tyre, despite recurring complaints about his unsettling downshifts.

Hamilton swiftly improved upon the Dutchman's lap, using softs to set a 1m35.561s. But when Leclerc took over command with a 1m35.127s despite using the slower mediums, that underlined there was still a lot more pace to find.
Entering the final 20 minutes, Antonelli took a tenth out of Leclerc's time on softs, but his lap was scratched for breaking track limits at Turn 9.
Verstappen did adhere to the white lines to set a 1m35.061s and go top, with Red Bull the quickest car through sector one, only for Hamilton to dip below the 1m35s barrier with a 1m34.893s.
Track limits, which have been a recurring theme throughout practice, also kept Leclerc from reclaiming first as he dipped over the white line at Turn 10.
That meant the Monegasque had to settle for third behind Hamilton and Verstappen, setting up a finely poised qualifying session on Saturday afternoon.

Championship leader Antonelli was fourth ahead of Mercedes team-mate George Russell, as the Silver Arrows appears to be a half-step behind on pure pace, with Piastri sixth in the difficult to tame MCL40.
In the Audi, Nico Hulkenberg kept McLaren’s Lando Norris from seventh, with the world champion’s 1m35.2s also deleted for track limits at Turn 10.
Alpine driver Pierre Gasly was ninth, a full second behind Hamilton, with Isack Hadjar 10th in the second Red Bull as the Frenchman was left frustrated by his car's handling.

detailZh: 丹尼尔·里卡多在美国大奖赛前夕的现场表演令F1粉丝感到惊喜
前F1车手丹尼尔·里卡多与音乐家罗布·贝尔德一起吹奏口琴，令粉丝感到惊喜
丹尼尔·里卡多，Drive to Survive第七季
赛车文化超越赛道。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事。
前一级方程式车手丹尼尔·里卡多在美国德克萨斯州奥斯汀的舞台上出现了一个惊喜。
这位澳大利亚人与歌手兼词曲作者罗布·贝尔德一起加入了福特赛车和Enchanté快闪活动，在周五晚上一起演奏他与美国大奖赛旅途中共创作的原创歌曲。
一位粉丝在Instagram上发布的表演视频，截至写作时已经获得了超过7000个赞。一位粉丝评论说：“这治愈了我心中的某一部分，”另一位粉丝补充说：“我敢打赌他上辈子要么是鲍勃·迪伦的兄弟，要么是个牛仔哈哈。我们爱你，丹尼尔。”
“在这个时候，没有人关心比赛。很高兴看到丹尼尔回来了，即使他不再赛车，”另一位粉丝写道，另一位粉丝写道：“作为一个音乐家和蜜獾粉丝，和丹尼·里卡多一起演奏是我的梦想。”
“我是说真的很长的一段路。沙漠、乡村小道、游泳洞，所有这些。说实话，我迫不及待了。”
这次长途旅行是推广新系列 Enchanté Collection 的活动之一，名为《长途》。这些新产品在奥斯汀的 Distribution Hall 的临时展位上出售，展位上还有食品、饮料、闪粉纹身和赛车模拟器。
里卡多也被看到在支持 小红牛 车队的车手利亚姆·劳森，作为新西兰人，他在 Esses Bazaar ATX 活动中担任主角，与利亚姆·劳森和朋友们一起在东第六街的 Inn Cahoots 举办车库音乐会，此次活动是为本周末的美国大奖赛做准备。
detailEn: Daniel Ricciardo surprises F1 fans with on-stage performance ahead of US GP
Former Formula 1 driver Daniel Ricciardo surprised fans with a harmonica performance alongside musician Rob Baird
Daniel Ricciardo , Drive to Survive Season 7
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
Former Formula 1 driver Daniel Ricciardo made a surprise appearance on stage in Austin, Texas, with American singer-songwriter Rob Baird.
The Australian joined Baird at the Ford Racing and Enchanté pop-up on Friday night to play harmonica on an original song he co-wrote with Baird during a road trip to the United States Grand Prix.

A fan video of the performance, posted on Instagram, had picked up more than 7000 likes by the time of writing. "This healed something in me," one fan commented, while another added: "I'm sure he was either Bob Dylan's brother or a cowboy in a previous life lol. We love you, Daniel."

"At this point, no one cares about the race. Glad to see Daniel back, even if he’s not racing," someone else posted, and another fan wrote: "As a musician and a honey badger fan, it would be a dream to play with Danny Ric."
"And I mean the lonnnng way. Desert, backroads, swimming holes, all of it. Not gonna lie, I can't wait."

The road trip was part of the promotion of the new Enchanté collection, The Long Road. The new products are being sold at a pop-up at Distribution Hall in Austin alongside food, drinks, flash tattoos and racing simulators.

Ricciardo was also spotted supporting Racing Bulls driver Liam Lawson as the New Zealander headlined Garage Sessions with Liam Lawson and Friends as part of Esses Bazaar ATX, held at Inn Cahoots on East Sixth Street ahead of this weekend's United States Grand Prix.

detailZh: 尼科·胡肯伯格在美国大奖赛上被加布里埃尔·博特洛托恶作剧后颜面扫地
加布里埃尔·博特洛托在美国大奖赛期间的一次粉丝见面会上玩了一个意外的恶作剧，让他的奥迪车队队友笑得前仰后合
赛车文化超越赛道。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事
年轻的奥迪车手加布里埃尔·博特洛托在美洲赛道前与队友尼科·胡肯伯格走在一起时，对他进行了一次恶作剧。两位车手在奥斯汀观众的欢呼声中走出，巴西人拉下了队友的裤子。
这个时刻的视频已经迅速走红，展示了胡肯伯格在周五如何走上舞台，当时博尔特洛从后面抓住他的裤子并将其拉下，引发了观众的欢呼和笑声。这位德国人对此玩笑表示宽容，一边笑着一边整理好衣服。
这个恶作剧为博尔特洛艰难的周末带来了一些轻松。巴西人在周日美国大奖赛将从最后一排发车，因为奥迪为他提供的动力单元组件超出了分配额度。
博尔特洛和胡肯伯格自2025年以来一直是队友，当时车队还以萨博的身份参赛，尽管车队已被德国巨头奥迪接管，但他们成为了赛场上更为轻松的搭档之一。然而，车队在2026年很难获得积分。车队在车队积分榜上排名第八，积分为23分，胡肯伯格积13分，博尔特洛积10分。
博尔特洛在美国大奖赛周末赛前表示：“我在可靠性方面看到了很多改进。显然，我们在新加坡显然有一个问题，我们相信我们已经找到了原因。”
“这显然不是理想的情况，但与此同时，它发生的时候我并没有在前面真正地竞争，所以这让我对它稍微不那么沮丧。但我希望我们能够在接下来的赛季中没有任何重大问题，并且能够以最佳状态完成比赛和排位赛，驾驶我们能够驾驶的最好的汽车，从中提取一切。”
detailEn: Nico Hulkenberg left red-faced after Gabriel Bortoleto prank at United States GP
Gabriel Bortoleto left his Audi team-mate laughing after pulling an unexpected prank during a fan appearance at the United States Grand Prix
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.

Young Audi driver Gabriel Bortoleto played a prank on his team-mate Nico Hulkenberg as the pair walked out in front of thousands of fans at the Circuit of the Americas. With both drivers walking out to cheers from the Austin crowds, the Brazilian pulled down his team-mate's trousers.

Videos of this moment have gone incredibly viral, showing Hulkenberg making his way onto the stage on Friday when Bortoleto grabbed his trousers from behind and pulled them down, to loud cheers and laughter from the crowd. The German took the joke in good humour, laughing as he pulled his clothes straight.

The prank offered some light relief on a tough weekend for Bortoleto. The Brazilian will start Sunday’s United States Grand Prix from the back of the grid, after Audi took him beyond his allocation of power unit components.

Bortoleto and Hulkenberg have been team-mates since 2025, when the team still raced as Sauber, and have formed one of the more light-hearted partnerships on the grid despite it being taken over by German giant Audi. The outfit has found points hard to come by in 2026, however. The team is eighth in the constructors’ championship on 23 points, with the experienced Hulkenberg on 13 and Bortoleto on 10.

"I have seen lots of improvement on reliability," Bortoleto said on Thursday ahead of the United States Grand Prix race weekend. "I think we had one [issue] in Singapore obviously, that we believe we found the reason of.

"It was obviously something not ideal to happen, but at the same time it happened when I was not really fighting at the front, so made me a little bit less upset about it. But I hope we are able to do the rest of the season without having any major issue and that we are able to just complete the races and qualifying in the best condition and the best car possible out there that we can drive and extract everything from it."
